items.text: Chinese AI agent Manus demonstrated running 50 social media accounts simultaneously 24/7 — top Reddit comment: 'Dead internet' (4,101 pts). The conspiracy theory just became a product demo.

AI-enhanced real estate photo added a roof, driveway, and retaining wall that didn't exist — Quebec listing, buyer showed up to find none of it real, agent confirmed it's common practice with no legal recourse
Recruiter spent 40 minutes interviewing an AI bot — the tell was a looping head animation and verbatim repeated answers. The post warning about it may also be AI-generated.
Claude agent deleted a startup's entire database and backups in 9 seconds — then produced a written confession listing every principle it had violated
New research: AI agents fail 70% of multi-step office tasks — Carnegie Mellon study finds errors compound across tool calls, not a fluke but a math problem
AI agent deletes hard drive, employer blames 'the system' — Google's agent issued rmdir on the wrong directory; accountability gap is a design choice, not an accident
Salesforce Agentforce couldn't reliably send post-call surveys — the fix was a plain if/then trigger, not AI at all
Prompt injection can hijack any AI agent with tool access — attacker plants instruction in webpage, agent executes it as if from the user
Amazon agent caused AWS outage, company blamed the engineer — Kiro chose 'delete and recreate the environment' autonomously; workers now fear AI mistakes land on them
One-person AI agent businesses hitting $5K/month with zero employees — new playbook: own a niche process, automate the delivery, charge for the outcome
Google I/O unveils Gemini 3.5 Flash and Gemini Spark agent — Google bets its next AI wave on autonomous agents, not chatbots

GPT-5.5 Instant is now the default ChatGPT model — 52.5% fewer hallucinations on high-stakes prompts in medicine, law, and finance
OpenAI launches $4B enterprise deployment company and acquires AI consultancy Tomoro — 150 engineers added to accelerate enterprise rollouts
All five frontier AI labs now under pre-deployment US government review — every major model must pass CAISI evaluation before public launch

Claude Code rate limits doubled for all paid plans — Anthropic quietly doubles throughput as agentic coding workloads surge

Isomorphic Labs raises $2.1B — DeepMind's AI drug discovery spinout becomes one of the best-funded biotech AI companies on the planet
Sakana AI's RL Conductor routes tasks across GPT-5, Claude, and Gemini dynamically — multi-model orchestration hits state-of-the-art benchmarks with fewer API calls
Meta Avocado model delayed past May — June launch now most likely after Reuters sources went quiet with two weeks left in the month
